name: Youth Programs: Trail Work Parties
what_you_do: Youth build and fix hiking trails on one-day work parties and some multi-day trips, with trained crew leaders. Teams of youth can also book a private work party.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 10 to 18. Under 14 must have a parent, guardian or teacher with them.
duration: Work parties run Tuesday to Sunday; one day or multi-day
deadline_text: No deadline. Choose a work party any time (search the work party page).
how_to_apply: Search the WTA work party list, pick one and sign up online. Youth groups can contact WTA to set up a private work party.
notes: The overview page does not say whether youth work parties are unpaid; it describes them as volunteer service hours. Multi-day shared-identity trail trips are also offered. Details on gear, rides and sign-up are on the work party page, not read here. Youth group bookings: volunteer@wta.org.
